subject: Northshore Health RFI — PHI handling & evidence requests
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@northshorehealth.org>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@northshorehealth.org
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: RFI: PHI handling + evidence package request

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for the intro last week. As part of Northshore's platform evaluation (final stage), our security and compliance team has a short RFI focused on PHI handling and supporting evidence. We've attached a spreadsheet with specific items — architecture diagrams, encryption-at-rest and in-transit details, sample audit logs, and details on our BAA negotiation path.

Can your team provide:
- A concise dataflow diagram showing PHI ingress, processing, and egress (including any third-party processors).
- A sample audit log extract showing retention metadata and event types (redacted).
- SOC2/HIPAA evidence summary and the expected timeline to provide full artifacts under an NDA/BAA.

We're targeting supplier selection by 6/18 and need the evidence package this week if possible. If anything requires a legal review before sharing, please flag the items and an expected delivery date.

Best,
Emily
Emily Park
Security Program Manager
Northshore Health

Attachment: northshore-evidence-request.xlsx (spreadsheet of RFI questions)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@northshorehealth.org>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: RFI: PHI handling + evidence package request

Emily —

Thanks for the clarity and the spreadsheet. Looping in Monica (Security & Compliance) and Aditya (Solutions Engineering) to coordinate the evidence pack. High level answers inline — we will follow up with attachments and the dataflow PDF within 24 hours.

Quick notes now:
- Dataflow: PHI may be sent via API (TLS 1.2+/mTLS optional) to our hosted inference endpoints. For Private/Dedicated deployments we support VPC peering and customer-managed networking — in that case PHI never traverses public networks. We'll attach a diagram that shows both hosted and Private flows.
- Encryption: TLS in transit; AES-256 at rest for model artifacts and persisted caches where applicable; KMS integration (customer or Redwood-managed).
- Audit logs: we retain request-level metadata (timestamp, route, model version, truncated prompt hash) for 90 days by default; longer retention can be configured for Dedicated/Private. We will include a redacted sample.
- BAA timeline: we have a standard BAA addendum and SOC2 summary; legal usually turns around initial BAA comments within 3–5 business days once NDA/POC approvals are in place.

We will push a ZIP containing: redwood_phi_dataflow_diagram.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf, and the requested sample logs. If Northshore needs anything in a different format (csv, slides), say the word.

Thanks —
Rohan
Director, Field Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (will send evidence ZIP in next message)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@northshorehealth.org>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: RFI: PHI handling + evidence package request

Emily —

Following up with the artifacts attached. Highlights and clarifications below: see attached files for diagrams and the SOC2 snapshot.

Key clarifications:
- Data residency: For hosted customers, we offer region pinning in our US regions (multi-az) and provide contract controls to limit cross-region fallbacks. For Dedicated/Private customers you select deployment region and can request air-gapped on-prem.
- Third-party processors: We use a small set of cloud storage and telemetry providers; all subprocessors are disclosed in our DPA and covered by contractual controls in our BAA.
- De-identification: We do not perform automated PHI redaction by default; customers can request configurable pre-processing hooks or run inference in a Private deployment for PHI-only workloads.
- Log samples: included with truncated identifiers and no prompt content; audit events are typed (AUTH, REQUEST_RECEIVED, MODEL_INVOKE, CACHE_HIT, ERROR), with timestamps and route id.

If Northshore needs any of these items added to the spreadsheet or needs a call to walk through the artifacts, we can make time tomorrow.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_phi_dataflow_diagram.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf, redwood_audit_sample_redacted.csv

Also looping Dr. Llewellyn for a short technical clarification on de-id/PHI processing. Can we schedule a 30-min call tomorrow at 11:00 AM ET to walk through the architecture and discuss Private deployment options?

Best,
Emily

Emily / team —

Thanks for the follow-ups. Quick technical answers and next steps before the call:

1) Prompt/response text in hosted mode: By default, we do not persist full request or response text in production logs. We persist a truncated prompt hash and metadata for debugging. Customers can opt-in to session logging (full text) for debugging/observability, but that requires explicit configuration and contractual acknowledgement in the BAA.

2) 365-day retention example: For audit logs we can offer a 365-day retention tier. Example: additional storage/ingestion costs estimated at ~$1.50 per 1000 requests/month for the audit store plus a small monthly archival fee; exact pricing depends on request volume and chosen encryption/customer KMS. We can provide a vendor quote once we have typical daily request rates.

3) BAA template: We host a current BAA template on DocuSign for faster signature cycles. I'll include the DocuSign link in the follow-up and share the redline-friendly PDF. If Northshore prefers to push counters via email, legal is ready.

Action items:
- I'll post the DocuSign BAA link and an example retention-cost worksheet by tomorrow morning.
- Rohan/Monica: offer 30-min slot for a technical walkthrough (Aditya will demo Private deployment toggle and log-retention config). Proposed: Thu 11:00 AM ET.

Appreciate the quick cadence —
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
